label: MCS-8M Dashboard
info:
Tablet/phone dashboard for a Sony MCS-8M: route sources to Aux 1 and Aux 2,
see what's selected (including changes made on the switcher's panel),
connection status, and a read-only DOWNLOAD ALL SETTINGS button.

Setup: double-click **EDIT SETTINGS HERE**. See examples/node-red/dashboard/README.md in
https://github.com/ispyisail/mcs8m-protocol

name: START HERE: double-click 'EDIT SETTINGS HERE' (names, buttons, repo folder)
info:
1. EDIT SETTINGS HERE - input names, which source each button selects, repo folder, port for the settings download.
2. Double-click the 'MCS-8M serial port' config (on any serial node) and set your port.
3. Button labels: double-click each button to rename it to match.

name: EDIT SETTINGS HERE
info:
source_names: name shown for each switcher input (1-14) in the 'Active' line.
buttons: the source number each of the 4 buttons selects, top to bottom - keep it in step with the button payloads.
repo_dir: where you cloned mcs8m-protocol (for DOWNLOAD ALL SETTINGS).
dump_port: the serial port, same as the serial config node.

name: DOWNLOAD ALL SETTINGS: frees the port, runs tools/mcs8m_dump.py (read-only), reclaims the port
info:
Releases the serial port, runs tools/mcs8m_dump.py, then reclaims the port.
Polling and buttons are paused while it runs (flow.dump_active).
The script only sends READ requests. Needs Python 3 and the repo at repo_dir (EDIT SETTINGS HERE).
